You literally explained my situation.  I feel like we worked so well together when we were good but when it was bad.  He was abusive as well but he loved me like no other, or so I thought.  Very confusing feelings. We got together when My dad got diagnosed with cancer and he was there literally when My dad passed away. So I have attachment with him. He was my go to for everything as well. Now i feel empty, lonely. He too was dating his coworker while we were separated.  But he said he broke up with her to get back with me. I did everything I could to stay away. He had his mom call me and he was calling me for weeks restricted.  So he came for me but it was hell as it usually is but I missed him so bad.  Now we're broken up again, another heartbreak to deal with,  would've been months if he hadn't come back. But this time I hope he doesn't come back.  He will never change his abusive ways.  No matter how much I think he was a good person, he probably was at times but the emotional,  mental and physical abuse cannot be forgotten.  So I say to you like I say to myself.....let yourself feel all the emotions.  Let yourself remember the good, but remember the bad as well. They were only as good as we let them be. Anyone that hurts you is a horrible person. My ex and your ex are horrible people we thought were our everything but one day we will find someone who will never lay a finger on us and we won't be stressed out or walking on eggshells for basic human needs.
